Energy Conversion
Air quality would be adversely affected during the operational life of a coal conversion facility. Airborne pollutants would disappear with elimination of the source, but soils could be permanently affected by atmospheric fallout of trace elements.
The plant site would be unavailable for other uses during construction and operation phases, but presumably the land could revert to other uses after the plant ceased operation and was dismantled
Socio-economic effects should not differ substantially in nature from those resulting from mining, although magnitudes of impacts would certainly be proportionately greater relative to increased inmigration, job opportunities and tax base.
